_comment: Sidecar metadata for a helicopter TDEM survey CSV deliverable.

column_map._sfz_format_note: sfz_n gate columns → indices 0..sfz_n-1 (here 0..19). 'bracket' → SFz[0]..SFz[19]; 'underscore' → SFz_00..SFz_19; 'zero_padded' → SFz00..SFz19. sfz_n is REQUIRED and must equal len(gate_times_ms).

system._waveform_note: on_time includes both ramps; gate times are referenced to the END of the turn-off ramp. bipolar_square + frequency + on_time makes the forward model the full pulse train (#22); ramp_off the finite turn-off (#52).
system._units_note: Declared, not assumed (#83): loader REJECTS any other units — no conversion exists. A deliverable in nT/s / ppm / pV/A must be converted upstream.
system._geometry_note: concentric_loop (VTEM-style, Rx at loop centre) or offset_dipole (+ tx_rx_separation_m)
system._noise_units: V/(A·m⁴) — same units as gate data; used as absolute error floor in quadrature with rel_error and per-gate SFz_std columns when present

_gate_times_note: Gate-CENTRE times in ms after turnoff. Length must equal sfz_n, and the last gate must fit inside the off-time: 1/(2·f) − on_time = 16 ms at 25 Hz / 4 ms on-time.
_gate_window_note: The forward evaluates the gate-centre instant only; real receivers integrate over a finite window. For contiguous log-spaced windows at this spacing the bias is ~1% (window-average/centre ≈ 1.008 at a late-time p=2.5 slope). The schema has no gate_start_ms/gate_end_ms fields, so delivered VTEM/SkyTEM window tables cannot yet be integrated over — the centre-point approximation is silent and unquantifiable per survey (#44).

inversion._mesh_note: depth_max ~1.5x estimated DOI (#63): diffusion depth at the 14.6 ms gate is ~480 m even at 10 ohm-m, so a 300 m mesh aliased the last ~5 gates into the basal half-space. 36 layers keeps ~11 interfaces/decade.
